lines.text: [wry] Ten machines. Ten terminals. And exactly one of you.
[confident] Put Connectra on each machine. Sign in once. That’s it — they all dial out and connect.
Now just ask. One chat finds every device, runs the update on each one, and tells you when it’s done.
[upbeat] And it’s not tied to one app. Web assistant, IDE, terminal — if it speaks MCP, it works.
AI builders. Infra teams. Developers. [playful] Honestly? Anyone with a phone.
[firm] The cloud can ask. Your machine decides.
[warm, confident] Every agent. Every device. Connected by Connectra.
